context: Retrieval as the context layer of LLM systems - the generation side of the learner's goal. Chunking tradeoffs (size/overlap, structure-aware, contextual enrichment); context assembly (selection/ordering, citation-grounded span attribution, metadata filters APPLIED here - mechanics in DE 301, window budgeting: relevance density over volume); the agentic lesson (single-shot rewriting/expansion/HyDE compressed to one topic, retrieval-as-a-tool loops with decide-to-stop policies, query decomposition/multi-hop, conversational rewriting across turns, self-correcting RAG, text-to-SQL as a retrieval tool); RAG evaluation (faithfulness, context precision/recall, answer relevance, RAGAS/DeepEval/TruLens landscape and the LLM-judge pitfall); RAG security (ACL-aware retrieval, tenant isolation in shared indexes, prompt injection via retrieved content - the learner runs a multi-tenant production system); latency/cost engineering (the retrieve/rerank/generate budget, caching layers, long-context vs retrieval).
